title: Unique Light Portuguese Blackeye Pea Grill
description: A jammy, aerated, light Portuguese dish featuring blackeye pea, nimono-simmer, macrobiotic-friendly, cooked in a raclette-grill vessel
instructions: Rinse the dried blackeye peas and soak them in water for at least 8 hours
Drain and rinse the soaked blackeye peas
In a large pot, heat the olive oil over medium heat
Add the chopped onion and cook until it is translucent
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute
Add the blackeye peas, sea salt, black pepper, and water to the pot
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 30 minutes
Preheat the raclette-grill vessel to medium-high heat
Add the cooked blackeye pea mixture to the raclette-grill vessel and cook for 10 minutes
Squeeze the lemon juice over the blackeye pea mixture and serve
